prompt: In the vibrant anime style, a lively rooftop party unfolds under a starry night sky. On the left, a girl with pink pigtails stands holding a glowing sparkler, her eyes wide with excitement as she looks at the fireworks above. Next to her, a boy in a blue hoodie sits on the concrete ledge, his legs dangling over the edge while he leans back casually. In the center, a table laden with snacks holds a large pizza box and several soda cans. A cat with orange fur jumps onto the table, knocking over a red cup, its tail flicking angrily. To the right of the table, a woman in a green dress points toward the horizon, directing the attention of a man in a black suit standing beside her. The man in the black suit adjusts his tie, looking where she indicates with a serious expression. Behind them, a tall speaker pulses with bass, vibrating slightly. There is no rain falling from the sky. The girl with pink pigtails hands a spare sparkler to the boy in the blue hoodie, who reaches out to take it with a smile. The orange cat stares intently at the pizza box, sniffing the air. The woman in the green dress rests her hand on the shoulder of the man in the black suit, sharing a quiet moment amidst the celebration. The scene captures the dynamic energy of youth and friendship against the urban backdrop.
